lines.t: One person made this Roblox game in 2018, and never made another one.

full.credit: Clips: Arutik Play; PrysMoon (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: Bee Swarm Simulator came out on March 23rd, 2018. Made by a solo developer named Onett.

full.credit: Clips: Arutik Play; PrysMoon (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: It was the 19th game on Roblox to hit a billion visits. Now it has over 4 billion.

full.credit: Clips: Arutik Play; PrysMoon (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: Most simulators die in a year or two. Onett just kept updating this one.

full.credit: Clips: Arutik Play; PrysMoon (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: Did you ever play Bee Swarm?

full.credit: Clips: Arutik Play; PrysMoon (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)
